title: This Deep-Sea Bug Went Over 5 Years Without a Single Meal
subject: giant isopod

scenes.text: This animal skipped dinner for more than five years.
It's a giant isopod, a foot-long crustacean from the deep sea, living at an aquarium in Japan.
In January 2009, it nibbled a mackerel. Then it never ate again.
Keepers tried new foods, moved meals closer, and changed the water temperature. Nothing worked.
It lived on until February 2014, over five years later.
The autopsy found no blockage and no clear cause. Scientists still can't explain how it lasted that long.

description:
This animal skipped dinner for more than five years.
A giant isopod at Toba Aquarium in Japan stopped eating in January 2009 and lived until February 2014.
How long could you go without food?
